The name of the topic to monitor for messages.
This parameter does not support regular expressions. The topic
name must be either a SOW topic, a view or a conflated topic.
Queues are not supported.
There is no default for this parameter.

The message type of the topic to monitor for messages.
There is no default for this parameter.

The value to store when an out-of-focus notification is received for
a tracked message.
There is no default for this parameter.
